content:
Field
Description
AndroidManagementMode
The management mode of the device according to Android Enterprise definitions.
Values:
MANAGEMENT_MODE_UNSPECIFIED (0)
DEVICE_OWNER (1)
PROFILE_OWNER (2)
UNMANAGED (3)
AndroidDeviceOwnership
Ownership of the managed device according to Android Enterprise definitions.
Values:
OWNERSHIP_UNSPECIFIED (0)
COMPANY_OWNED (1)
PERSONALLY_OWNED (2)
AndroidUpdateStatus
Indication of whether an update is available for the device and, if so, the type of update.
For Android versions 14 and earlier, this value is always UPDATE_STATUS_UNKNOWN (0).
Values:
UPDATE_STATUS_UNKNOWN (0)
UP_TO_DATE (1)
UNKNOWN_UPDATE_AVAILABLE (2)
SECURITY_UPDATE_AVAILABLE (3)
OS_UPDATE_AVAILABLE (4)
AndroidManagementAppPackageName
The package name of the app that manages the device. This value is empty if no app is managing the device.
For MDMs that have migrated to AMAPI from Custom DPC, this value is com.google.android.apps.work.clouddpc.
AndroidSystemSecurityPatchLevel
The security patch level of the system component. This value is empty if its value could not be determined.
AndroidVendorSecurityPatchLevel
The security patch level of the vendor component. This value might be empty.
AndroidKernelVersion
The kernel version on the device. This value might be empty.
AndroidSystemModulesSecurityPatchLevel The security patch level of the system modules component. This value might be empty.
